{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(targets)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(RcppML)
library(Matrix)
library(destiny)
library(cowplot)
library(DT)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))

CLUST_COL  <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9"
COND_PAL   <- c(WT = "#1f78b4", "mCh-" = "#a6cee3", "mCh+" = "#e31a1c")
```

```{r load}
tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
tar_load(phate_coords_hsc)
tar_load(fa2_coords_hsc)

# Slot precomputed embeddings — barcodes shared with fullcc
add_dimreduc <- function(srt, coords, name, key) {
  shared <- intersect(colnames(srt), rownames(coords))
  coords  <- coords[shared, , drop = FALSE]
  srt[[name]] <- Seurat::CreateDimReducObject(
    embeddings = coords, key = key, assay = DefaultAssay(srt)
  )
  srt
}

srt <- add_dimreduc(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, phate_coords_hsc, "phate", "PHATE_")
srt <- add_dimreduc(srt,                      fa2_coords_hsc,   "fa2",   "FA2_")
rm(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, phate_coords_hsc, fa2_coords_hsc); gc()

cat("Loaded:", ncol(srt), "cells |", CLUST_COL, "—",
    nlevels(srt@meta.data[[CLUST_COL]]), "clusters\n")
```

# 2 · NMF

Non-negative Matrix Factorisation decomposes SCT expression into `k` gene
programs (W, genes × k) and per-cell activities (H, k × cells). Run on
non-HVG genes so programs capture stable transcriptional structure not already
dominant in the PCA/UMAP.

```{r nmf-run}
NMF_K    <- 10L
NMF_SEED <- 42L

mat_nmf <- Seurat::GetAssayData(srt, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")
mat_nmf <- mat_nmf[!rownames(mat_nmf) %in% Seurat::VariableFeatures(srt), ]
cat("NMF matrix:", nrow(mat_nmf), "genes ×", ncol(mat_nmf), "cells\n")

nmf_res <- RcppML::nmf(mat_nmf, k = NMF_K, seed = NMF_SEED, tol = 1e-4,
                       verbose = FALSE)

h_df           <- as.data.frame(t(nmf_res$h))
colnames(h_df) <- paste0("NMF_", seq_len(ncol(h_df)))
rownames(h_df) <- colnames(srt)
srt            <- Seurat::AddMetaData(srt, h_df)
cat("NMF complete — k =", NMF_K, "\n")
```

## MSE by component

```{r nmf-mse, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
mse_vals <- sapply(seq_len(NMF_K), function(i) {
  recon <- nmf_res$w[, i, drop = FALSE] %*% nmf_res$h[i, , drop = FALSE]
  mean((mat_nmf - recon)^2)
})

ggplot(data.frame(k = seq_len(NMF_K), mse = mse_vals), aes(k, mse)) +
  geom_line(colour = "steelblue4") +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue4", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(NMF_K)) +
  labs(x = "NMF component", y = "MSE",
       title = "Per-component reconstruction MSE") +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 11)
```

## Program activity — UMAP

```{r nmf-umap, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
FeaturePlot(srt, features = paste0("NMF_", seq_len(NMF_K)),
            reduction = "umap.nn", ncol = 4, pt.size = 0.2, order = TRUE) &
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "plasma") &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9))
```

## Program activity — PHATE

```{r nmf-phate, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
FeaturePlot(srt, features = paste0("NMF_", seq_len(NMF_K)),
            reduction = "phate", ncol = 4, pt.size = 0.2, order = TRUE) &
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "plasma") &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9))
```

## Top genes per component

```{r nmf-top-genes}
w_mat           <- nmf_res$w
rownames(w_mat) <- rownames(mat_nmf)

top_genes_nmf <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(ncol(w_mat)), function(k) {
  scores <- sort(w_mat[, k], decreasing = TRUE)
  data.frame(component = paste0("NMF_", k),
             gene = names(scores)[1:20],
             score = round(scores[1:20], 4))
}))

datatable(top_genes_nmf, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
          caption = "Top 20 genes per NMF component (W matrix loading)",
          options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```

```{r nmf-cleanup, include=FALSE}
rm(mat_nmf, nmf_res, h_df, w_mat, top_genes_nmf, mse_vals); gc()
```

# 3 · Diffusion Map

Diffusion Map (`destiny`) captures continuous manifold structure by computing
eigenvectors of the diffusion operator on the cell–cell similarity graph.
Run on SCT HVGs.

```{r dm-run}
hvg    <- Seurat::VariableFeatures(srt)
mat_dm <- t(as.matrix(
  Seurat::GetAssayData(srt, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")[hvg, ]
))
cat("DiffusionMap input:", nrow(mat_dm), "cells ×", ncol(mat_dm), "HVGs\n")

set.seed(42)
dm     <- destiny::DiffusionMap(mat_dm)

dc_emb           <- destiny::eigenvectors(dm)
rownames(dc_emb) <- colnames(srt)
colnames(dc_emb) <- paste0("DC_", seq_len(ncol(dc_emb)))

srt[["diffmap"]] <- Seurat::CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = dc_emb, key = "DC_", assay = "SCT"
)

srt <- Seurat::RunUMAP(srt, reduction = "diffmap", dims = 1:20,
                       reduction.name = "umap_dm", reduction.key = "UMAPdm_",
                       verbose = FALSE)
cat("Diffusion UMAP ready.\n")
```

## Eigenvalue spectrum

```{r dm-evals, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
evals <- destiny::eigenvalues(dm)
ggplot(data.frame(DC = seq_along(evals), eigenvalue = evals), aes(DC, eigenvalue)) +
  geom_line(colour = "steelblue4") +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue4", size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Diffusion component", y = "Eigenvalue",
       title = "Diffusion Map eigenvalue spectrum") +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 11)
```

## UMAP comparison: SNN-PCA vs Diffusion

```{r dm-compare, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
p1 <- DimPlot(srt, reduction = "umap.nn", group.by = CLUST_COL,
              label = TRUE, repel = TRUE) +
  NoLegend() + ggtitle("SNN-PCA UMAP")

p2 <- DimPlot(srt, reduction = "umap_dm", group.by = CLUST_COL,
              label = TRUE, repel = TRUE) +
  NoLegend() + ggtitle("Diffusion Map UMAP")

p1 | p2
```

```{r dm-cond, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
DimPlot(srt, reduction = "umap_dm", group.by = "sample.name",
        cols = COND_PAL, pt.size = 0.3) +
```

```{r dm-dc-umap, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
dc_meta           <- as.data.frame(dc_emb[, 1:6])
srt               <- Seurat::AddMetaData(srt, dc_meta)

FeaturePlot(srt, features = paste0("DC_", 1:6),
            reduction = "umap.nn", ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.2, order = TRUE) &
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "mako") &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9))
```
